notes: 0019: checks upload history in batches of at most 2000 files and releases each result map before the next batch. Warm checks use metadata and cached fingerprints without reading video content. History checks share the existing two-scan limit across rules, support stop checks during metadata work and between batches, and show aggregate throttled progress. Stopping during a check no longer reports all files uploaded. Legacy forum history now uses indexed source lookups instead of loading all topic records; schema 12 adds a covering index while preserving history. Target/topic, content-change and reservation guards remain intact. Includes eight regression tests and synthetic 100000-file cache measurements.
